about: The Tutor's tools for agents (Agent Link's tool-data format).

tutor_point.description: Point at FreeCAD's controls for the person: numbered rings and a callout over the window; faces and edges lit in 3D. Never moves the cursor, opens a menu or switches workbench. targets (≤6): {cmd: "PartDesign_Pad"}, {menu: ["Part Design", "Pad"]}, {wb: "PartDesignWorkbench"}, {task: "Length" | {name, label, button}}, {tree: "Sketch"}, {face: {normal: [0,0,1], largest: true}, of}, {edge: {near: [x,y,z]}, of} (of beside the query), {sub: "Face6", of}, {dock: "Report view"}, {view: "3d"}. Replaces earlier highlights unless clear: false; no targets clears. Says why any target is not shown.

ms.description: Gone after this long; left out: until the next call.

tutor.description: Run a FreeCAD lesson in the person's window. list (query filters); start {lesson: id, or inline {id: "inline.x", title, steps ≤8}, mode}; next, back, hint, skip, do, stop, status {detail}. demo: next does the step through the tools, then waits at the following one. guided: the person does it; checked on their actions and yours, on to the next 0.6 s after a pass. hint climbs 3 rungs (nudge, exact field, exact value), do is "Do it for me". mode switches mid-lesson. Answers {lesson, mode, step: "n/m", say, check: pass|fail|pending, why, hint, targets: {resolved, missing}}; while it runs a rider line (tutor: step n/m …) joins your other answers.

lesson.description: start: a lesson id (or its last part), or an inline lesson.

mode.description: start's mode (guided by default); with another action, switches.

query.description: list: words in the title, id or tags.

detail.description: status: the steps still to come too.
